title: Three Summers and One Short Spoon
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：lemon　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 lemon 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the grocer ① squeezed the lemon that no customer in the shop would have recorded, and he said the squeezing was the whole of the summer. The ② lemon, meaning the fruit itself and not the spoon, ran three summers and stayed unrecorded in the book; a lemon, he said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ lemon in that shop had the same short spoon beside it, and the ④ lemon at the far shelf, meaning the slice they kept for the children to suck and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A lemon, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the grocer said the recording is the part that fills three summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the lemon was the whole of the matter, meaning the sourness and not the fruit. The ⑥ lemon, meaning the sourness and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; lemon, he said, is either something you squeeze or the only word that means both a fruit and a sourness. He said the sourness is the part they remember.

By 1964 the ⑦ lemon had become a line in a recipe, and the recipe had become an argument about the short spoon. The ⑧ lemon of the whole thing, the grocer wrote in July, was one shop and three summers of recording; lemon, he said, is either the slice at the far shelf or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ lemon I remember is the fruit recorded in the recipe, which closed in 1966 and is still recorded as the quietest in the shop. A ⑩ lemon, my mother said in 1968, is the only fruit that improves by being recorded; every lemon, she said, is a sourness that has agreed to look like a fruit. She said the sourness was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 柠檬；柠檬果（指铺子里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 柠檬；柠檬果（指那个柠檬本身，与勺子相对）
C. 固定搭配：squeeze the lemon 榨这个柠檬
D. n. 柠檬；柠檬果（指留给孩子们含着的那一瓣那一个）
E. n. 果味之事（抽象总称，指一处铺子的柠檬之事）
F. n. 柠檬；柠檬果（指方子里写到、被记载的的那一个）
G. n. 酸味、酸涩（指一件事里人人都榨却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 酸涩（抽象总称，指人人都榨却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: squeezed the lemon that no customer in the shop would have recorded
The lemon, meaning the fruit itself and not the spoon
the lemon at the far shelf
the lemon was the whole of the matter
the lemon had become a line in a recipe
The lemon of the whole thing
A lemon, my mother said in 1968

answers.why: squeeze the lemon 意为“榨这个柠檬”，1959 年那位杂货店主把铺子里没有一位顾客肯记载的一个柠檬做了一遍。
lemon 意为“柠檬；柠檬果”，指那个柠檬本身而不是勺子，它经过了三个夏天而在簿子上没有被记载。
lemon 意为“柠檬；柠檬果”，指铺子里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一把小小的勺子。
lemon 意为“柠檬；柠檬果”，指最远那层货架留给孩子们含着的那一瓣那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
lemon 意为“酸味、酸涩”，指一件事里人人都榨却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份酸味就是那件事的全部。
lemon 意为“酸涩”，指人人都榨却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个柠檬，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
lemon 意为“柠檬；柠檬果”，指方子里写到、被记载的的那一个，到 1964 年这一个成了方子里的一行。
lemon 意为“果味之事”，杂货店主七月写道，整件事的柠檬之事是一处铺子和三个夏天的记载。
lemon 意为“柠檬；柠檬果”，我记得的是方子里记载过的那一个，1966 年榨好了，至今仍被说成铺子里最安静的一个。
lemon 为抽象总称，母亲 1968 年说，柠檬是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的柠檬。
